notes.subject: ruakh
notes.rationale: רוח e šomišwa ka moka go ya le D2 — moya/phefo/go hema ka lentšu le tee; 'go ruša ruakh' ke sekopanywa sa kgethwa

notes.subject: sekgekedi
notes.rationale: אויל: 'sekgekedi' (yo a se nago tlhalošo) kgahlanong le 'selaodi' — AOWA go ya le D2

notes.subject: ו
notes.rationale: 'gomme' e bopa leswika la pele la mohlanka — tokomane e nyaka gomme e a bopišwa

translation: Yo a tshwenyago ⟨את⟩ ntlo ya gagbo o tla ruša ruakh; gomme sekgekedi e tla ba mohlanka wa yo a nago le pelo ya bohlale.

tokens.gloss: wa yo a nago le bohlale
